If what you need is a lawful payment request, the message can be direct without intimidation. For example:

“Subject: Outstanding balance and proposed resolution

Hello [Name],

Our records show an outstanding balance of [amount] relating to [invoice or agreement]. Please review the attached documentation and contact [legitimate contact] by [date] so we can confirm the account and discuss payment options. If the amount is disputed, reply with the relevant information and we will place the account on hold while it is reviewed. You may also contact [independent complaints or mediation service] if we cannot resolve the matter directly. Please do not send cash or personal information by reply; use the verified payment channel listed on our official website.

Regards,

For fiction, the scene can communicate fear without supplying a reusable threat. A ransom demand involving a threat of violence is an emergency and should be handled by trained authorities, not drafted as correspondence. In any real case, prioritize immediate safety, preserve evidence exactly as received, and let trained investigators determine whether the threat is credible.
